title: Dust at Sundown
logline: A lone cowboy outruns three bandits across the desert at sunset.

scenes.axis: the chase runs along the trail and the camera stays on the sun side

entities.label: the three bandits on dark horses

camera.exit_frame: Jack at the right third, bandits far behind on the left third.

shots.prompt_still: Wide eye-level profile of Jack galloping toward screen-right, center of frame. Far behind him at the left edge, three bandits in dusters ride the same way.
shots.prompt_motion: Jack gallops toward screen-right and drifts to the right third. The bandits stay far behind on the left third. The camera pans.
shots.start_state: Wide profile: Jack galloping screen-right at center. Three bandits far behind at the left edge.
shots.end_state: Wide profile: Jack at the right third galloping screen-right. The bandits far behind on the left third.

camera.exit_frame: Jack at the right third. Bandits closer behind on the left third.

shots.prompt_still: Medium low-angle profile of Jack on the right third, riding toward screen-right, dusters on the bandits in the background on the left third, still behind him.
shots.prompt_motion: The bandits close from far to background on the left third. Jack keeps riding toward screen-right. The camera pans.
shots.start_state: Wide profile: Jack at the right third galloping screen-right. The bandits far behind on the left third.
shots.end_state: Medium profile: Jack at the right third riding screen-right. The bandits in the background on the left third, still behind him.

camera.exit_frame: Jack twisted toward screen-left. Bandits behind on the left third.

shots.prompt_still: Close shot of Jack on the right third, horse galloping toward screen-right. He twists his torso back toward screen-left. The bandits ride soft-focus in dusters on the left third, behind him.
shots.prompt_motion: Jack twists in the saddle toward screen-left and raises one warning shot into the air. His horse keeps galloping toward screen-right. The bandits stay behind on the left. The camera dollies in.
shots.start_state: Medium profile: Jack at the right third riding screen-right. The bandits in the background on the left third, still behind him.
shots.end_state: Close: Jack on the right third, torso twisted toward screen-left. Horse galloping screen-right. The bandits behind him on the left third.

camera.exit_frame: Jack small at the right edge. Bandits farther behind on the left third, still riding.

shots.prompt_still: Wide desert. Jack rides away toward screen-right, small at the right edge, dusters still on the bandits farther behind on the left third, still riding.
shots.prompt_motion: Jack rides on toward screen-right and grows smaller toward the right edge. The bandits drop farther behind, still riding, on the left third. The camera holds static.
